messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"verse":46,"chapter":5,"text":"And he said to me, “Ask the womb of a woman, and say to her, ‘If you bear ten children, why do you it at different times? Ask her therefore to give birth to ten children at once.”"},{"verse":47,"chapter":5,"text":"I said, “She can’t, but must do it each in their own time.”"},{"verse":48,"chapter":5,"text":"Then said he to me, “Even so, I have given the womb of the earth to those who are sown in it in their own times."},{"verse":49,"chapter":5,"text":"For just as a young child may not give birth, neither she who has grown old any more, even so have I organized the world which I created.”"},{"verse":50,"chapter":5,"text":"I asked, “Seeing that you have now shown me the way, I will speak before you. Is our mother, of whom you have told me, still young? Or does she now draw near to old age?”"}],"book_code":"2ES","chapter":5}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 46,47,48,49,50 in this chapter.
